name: cavemio-order-status
title: Order status
description: An order’s route with a parcel riding it: stops light as it passes, the arrival day rolls, and the carrier’s scans slide in.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The route is an ordered list with the current stop marked aria-current="step"; each stop says done or current to screen readers.
- The status chip is a status region, so a new stage is announced once; scans are a plain list.
- The parcel is a single composited layer moved along the route, never re-laid out per frame.
- Its light comes from your theme: the card mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, the route is 1px and 2px lines in the same light, and a cancelled order drains its colour. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Copy button, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the parcel and stops change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Where it is, at a glance
features.description: Five stops on a route; the parcel sits at the current one and the passed ones are lit.

features.title: Moves you can see
features.description: A new status sends the parcel along the route and lights each stop as it passes.

features.title: The day, large
features.description: eta reads as the weekday and date; a new date morphs and rolls, delivered reads Delivered.

features.title: Tracking in one tap
features.description: Carrier, tracking number with Copy, and a Track link out.

features.title: Scans as they come
features.description: events newest first, three until Show all; a new one slides in at the top.

features.title: Cancel before it ships
features.description: onCancel shows Cancel order while it’s ordered or packed; it asks once, then Cancelling → Cancelled.

states.title: ordered
states.description: The lit card with the order number, a status chip, Arriving and the date large, and the route with the parcel at Ordered; Cancel order under the scans.

states.title: moving
states.description: A new status sends the parcel along the thin line (1100ms) while the lit line follows; each stop lights in turn as the parcel passes and its label brightens. The chip morphs to the new stage.

states.title: date
states.description: When eta changes the weekday and month morph and the day rolls.

states.title: scan
states.description: A new event slides in at the top of Updates with the lit dot; older ones move down.

states.title: delivered
states.description: The parcel at the last stop, every stop lit, the headline Delivered with the day it arrived.

states.title: cancelled
states.description: Cancel order asks “Yes, cancel this order” (reverts after 4s), then Cancelling → Cancelled; the card loses its colour, the route dims and the date reads Not on its way.
